question: Will Hyperliquid (HYPE) exceed $80.75 on CoinGecko at 23:45 UTC on Oct 17, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the CoinGecko USD price for Hyperliquid (HYPE) at 2026-10-17T23:45:00.000Z is strictly greater than $80.75.
- "No": Wins if that same price is $80.75 or below.

Clarifications:
- The governing figure is CoinGecko's USD price for id "hyperliquid" (HYPE) at that instant — the last published value at or before 2026-10-17T23:45:00.000Z if there is no tick exactly then.
- CoinGecko is the measure. An exchange-specific pair such as Binance HYPE/USDT can fall on the opposite side of the threshold.
